funding.name: New Mexico Lottery Scholarship
funding.provides: The Lottery Scholarship, New Mexico's first tuition-free college program, covers 100% of tuition for recent New Mexico high school graduates.
funding.eligibility: Recent New Mexico high school graduates; must enroll part time or full time depending on the program.
funding.how_to_apply: Apply to a participating New Mexico public college or university, then complete the FAFSA.

funding.name: NMDWS State Apprenticeship Office tuition and training-cost assistance
funding.provider: New Mexico Department of Workforce Solutions
funding.provides: Registered apprenticeships combine paid on-the-job training with related classroom instruction; the NMDWS State Apprenticeship Office works with Local Workforce Development Boards to help participants with the cost of training, including tuition, training fees, and supplies and equipment.

funding.name: CNM Ingenuity Electric Lineworker Pre-Apprenticeship stipend
funding.provider: Central New Mexico Community College (CNM Ingenuity)
funding.provides: Through the BECA grant, eligible learners in the Electric Lineworker Pre-Apprenticeship receive hourly pay for training, described on the page as $16 an hour for 400 hours of training.
funding.eligibility: Eligible learners as defined by the BECA grant (see page).
funding.amount: $16 an hour for 400 hours of training (totaling $6,400), per the page
funding.how_to_apply: Visit the Electric Lineworker Pre-Apprenticeship webpage linked from the news item.
